description: This file defines an interface named WebMeeting that specifies external API methods for a meeting system, such as scheduling, inviting attendees, and listing meetings. It serves as a contract for implementing classes to interact with a web conferencing or meeting system.

methods.name: scheduleMeeting
methods.description: Schedule a meeting with the provided bean object.

methods.name: unscheduleMeeting
methods.description: Remove or cancel a scheduled meeting.

methods.name: inviteAttendee
methods.description: Invite an attendee to a meeting, with an option to send invites.

methods.name: uninviteAttendee
methods.description: Remove an attendee from a meeting.

methods.name: listMyMeetings
methods.description: List all meetings associated with the current user.

methods.name: getMeetingDetails
methods.description: Retrieve detailed information about a specific meeting.
